title: Noodle in the Soup
caption: Upbeat funky house track at 124 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat open hi-hats, claps, bouncy house piano chords, deep rolling bassline, bright synth stabs, playful energetic female pop vocal with a cheeky tone, catchy sing-along chorus, summer festival dance energy, clean modern mix

[Intro - house beat with piano stabs]
